notes.title: Patch Notes – v1.2.0 Update
notes.content:
This update includes important fixes, UI improvements, and new audio content:

🛵 Fixed the shaking issue with the moped.

🚗 Pressing G now teleports vehicles to your scrapyard.

🗺️ Minimap has been temporarily disabled.

✅ Task list text is now more visible.

⚙️ Adjustments made to the Game Settings menu.

🎵 7 new background tracks added.

🌿 Ambient sounds have been added to the game.

Thanks for your feedback—enjoy the game!

notes.title: Patch Notes – v1.1.1 Update
notes.content:
This update improves in-game guidance with new tips and helpful UI hints:

🧾 A tip board was added to the office explaining how to use the Organizer and Shredder.

🚗 A prompt now shows how to enter vehicles and open the trunk when near one.

🛠️ A message now tells you which key to press to open the Garage.

🏠 Hints have been added to explain how to sell storage units.

We're working to make the game easier to understand—thank you for your feedback!

notes.title: Patch Notes – v1.1.0 Update
notes.content:
This update adds support for two new languages!

🗣️ Polish language support

🗣️ Portuguese language support

More players can now enjoy the game in their native language. We truly appreciate your feedback!

notes.title: Patch Notes - v1.0.1 Update
notes.content:
This update brings several improvements to enhance your gameplay experience:

🔧 Various bugs have been fixed.

🔊 Audio cues have been added to notify you when your character is hungry.

🧃 Icons for plastic and glass items have been updated to make sorting easier.

Your feedback means a lot to us. Enjoy the game!
